title: annona neovelutina
intro: Annona neovelutina, commonly known as the velvet apple or velvet custard apple, is a species of flowering plant in the custard apple family. This plant is prized for its edible fruit and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The health benefits of Annona neovelutina include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include annonaceous acetogenins, which have been shown to have therapeutic actions including antiproliferative, antimalarial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
